sample.rationale: Both entries hold open the exact same unresolved question in different materials: does a persona change the substance of the thing wearing it, or is it purely relational/aesthetic dressing on an unchanged core? One asks it of an AI agent's gendered temperament (the Shopkeeper), the other of a human's public personas (LDN, Professor Compressor, TRICKSTER). Neither currently links to the other, and the pairing survives the fidelity swap — no other room member poses this question in its general form.
sample.evidence: Does Personifying: "does 'she' do any functional work, or is it purely relational and aesthetic?" / The Multilinear Self: "Each name is a projection of it — a real shadow the whole self casts into a particular room. Honest, just partial... the line between honest multiplicity and pretending."
